run_f_gold: run f_gold to count solutions of x squared mod p equals 1 in range 1 to n
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify correctness of modular arithmetic solutions
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which iterates x from 1 to p minus 1 checking x squared mod p equals 1
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use integer division instead of float division for cleaner arithmetic
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that counts modular congruence solutions by finding base solutions and extrapolating
